format: html
theme: darkly
embed-resources: true
---

```{r}
# packages
library(tidyverse)     # ecosystem of data science packages
library(rvest)         # for web scraping
library(sf)            # "simple features" (classes for maps)
library(usmap)         # map of US states (with Alaska & Hawaii)
library(RColorBrewer)  # Brewer color palettes
library(ggiraph)       # make ggplots interactive
```

```{r}
# run this command in the console
# (saves html file in your working directory)
download.file(
  url = "https://www.sofi.com/learn/content/average-salary-in-us/", 
  destfile = "sofi-average-salary-in-us-2025.html")
```

```{r}
tbls = read_html("sofi-average-salary-in-us-2025.html") |>
  html_table()

salaries = tbls[[1]]
head(salaries)
```

```{r}
# data with average and median salaries
salaries = salaries |>
  mutate(Average = as.numeric(str_remove_all(Average, "[,$]")),
         Median = as.numeric(str_remove_all(Median, "[,$]")))

head(salaries)
```

```{r}
# from package "usmap"
us_states = us_map(regions = "states")

class(us_states)

names(us_states)

head(us_states, n = 5)
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = us_states) +
  geom_sf()

ggplot(data = us_states) +
  geom_sf() +
  geom_sf_text(aes(label = abbr))

ggplot(data = us_states) +
  geom_sf() +
  geom_sf_text(aes(label = abbr)) +
  theme_void()
```

# Choropleth Map
```{r}
# inner join
joined_inner = inner_join(
    x = us_states, 
    y = salaries, 
    by = c("full" = "State"))

head(joined_inner)
```

```{r}
joined_inner |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = Average), color = "white") +
  theme_void()
```

```{r}
joined_inner |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = Average), color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#1b4bab", high = "#d7e1f5") +
  theme_void()
```

```{r}
joined_inner |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = Average), color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = brewer.pal(n = 7, name = "Purples"), 
                       breaks = seq(45000, 80000, by = 5000)) +
  theme_void()
```

## Interactive Map
```{r}
gmap = joined_inner |>
  mutate(Label = paste0(full, ": ", Average)) |>
  ggplot(aes(fill = Average,
             tooltip = Label)) +
  geom_sf_interactive(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = brewer.pal(n = 7, name = "Purples"), 
                       breaks = seq(45000, 80000, by = 5000)) +
  theme_void()

girafe(ggobj = gmap)
```

```{r}
# adding interactivity with "ggiraph" functions
gmap = joined_inner |>
  mutate(Label = paste0(full, ": ", Average)) |>
  ggplot(aes(fill = Average,
             tooltip = Label)) +
  geom_sf_interactive(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(direction = -1) +
  theme_void()

girafe(ggobj = gmap)
```
